# Pete Guzzo

Pete Guzzo is an Executive Producer + Operations Strategist based in Tampa, FL.
He's the person companies bring in when content, production, marketing, operations,
studios, and business strategy are all tangled together and someone needs to make
it work.

## Current Role

Executive Vice President, Shear Enterprises LLC (2024–present). Responsible for
marketing strategy, growth, organizational alignment, and AI-assisted operational
workflows across three business units: Rhonda Shear Intimates (global intimate
apparel brand), Shear Media Studios (11,000 sq. ft. multi-studio facility in St.
Petersburg, FL), and Up All Night Network (streaming/Roku channel).

## Career History

- Executive Vice President — Shear Enterprises LLC / Shear Media Studios (2024–present)
- Executive Content Strategist & Production Director — PG2, independent (2018–present)
- Founder / VP of Production & Integrated Content Strategy — Kestum Bilt (2015–2024)
- Director of Content & Integrated Producer — HSN / Qurate (2013–present, contract)
- Film & Content Director / Creative Producer — Tampa Digital Studios (2006–2013)

Education: MBA in Marketing & Project Management; BS in Film & Visual
Communications — both University of Tampa.

## Scale & Awards

- Kestum Bilt: grew to $1M+ annual revenue, 66% client retention, 100+ campaigns
- Tampa Digital Studios: $3.5M+ in production revenue; Telly Awards; National Addys;
  cut production time 35%, improved team efficiency 30%
- Seiko / Jimmie Johnson campaign: 80+ crew, five jurisdictions, high six-figure budget
- HSN: 40+ live campaigns per year; one livestream series lifted product sales 25%

## Key Clients

CSL Plasma, Wawa, Navy Federal Credit Union, Dick's Sporting Goods, Seiko (Jimmie
Johnson campaign), Cooper Tires, Robert Irvine / Food Network, NAPA Auto Parts,
Medi-Weightloss, Jackson Health System, American Cancer Society, University of
Florida, University of Southern California, Visit Tampa Bay, Greg Muzzillo /
Proforma, Hilton, Blue Emu, Brianna's (Del Sol), Boss Revolution, Margaritaville
Resorts, Srixon Golf, XXIO Golf, Just Bare Chicken, Purina, Ford, Habitat for
Humanity, UNICEF

## Studios

Pete designs and operates studios as operating systems — built for output, workflow,
and revenue, not just appearances.

- Shear Media Studios (St. Petersburg, FL) — 11,000 sq. ft. Soundstages, podcast
  and influencer suites, live-shopping environments, control room, multi-stream
  event production.
- 211 Studio (Tampa, FL) — A converted office building developed into a creative
  production hub.
